mutant.lineText: #need(pos: number, n: number): void { if (pos < this.#start || n < 0 || pos + n > this.#end) this.#fail('the data runs past the end of its section'); }
mutant.nextText: #uint(pos: number, n: number): number { let v = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) v = v * 256 + this.#buf[pos + i]!; return v; }
